content.user_title: Generate Custom Sound Effects with Sonilo
content.value_statement: Custom sound effects often require specialized audio tools and precise prompts. This skill turns a written sound concept and duration into a saved Sonilo audio file.
actual_capabilities: Generates one sound effect from a text description and required duration.
Exports WAV, MP3, AAC, or FLAC audio.
Saves generated audio to a selected output directory.
Retrieves completed results from timed-out asynchronous tasks.
limitations: Requires Sonilo access through MCP or an authenticated CLI.
API calls may consume credits or incur charges.
Does not synchronize sound effects to video footage.
Does not generate music or background scores.

use_cases.title: Create Game Feedback Sounds
use_cases.description: Generate impacts, pickups, alerts, and interface cues for interactive prototypes.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Interface Audio
use_cases.description: Create notification chimes, confirmation tones, and transition sounds for product experiences.

use_cases.title: Build Foley Layers
use_cases.description: Generate isolated material and movement sounds for later editing in an audio timeline.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Effect
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [duration]-second sound effect of [action]. Save it as [format].
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a simple sound from one clear action.

prompt_templates.title: Describe Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [action] involving [material], heard in [environment], lasting [duration] seconds.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add physical detail and acoustic context.

prompt_templates.title: Layer Multiple Elements
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [duration]-second effect combining [primary sound], [secondary texture], and [environmental detail].
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a richer effect from coordinated sound layers.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Stylized Cue
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-second [style] cue with [attack], [texture], [decay], and [listening perspective]. Exclude music.
prompt_templates.scenario: Control timing, character, envelope, and perspective.

output_examples.input: Generate six seconds of distant thunder with light rain in AAC format.
output_examples.output: A six-second AAC thunder clip is generated and saved as an M4A audio file.

output_examples.input: Create a two-second metallic interface confirmation sound in WAV format.
output_examples.output: A two-second WAV cue with a metallic attack and short decay is saved.

output_examples.input: Make eight seconds of heavy rain striking a tin roof in FLAC format.
output_examples.output: An eight-second FLAC ambience clip with rain and resonant metal texture is saved.

best_practices: Provide the duration before generation because the skill cannot infer length.
Describe the action, materials, environment, and style with concrete sound terms.
Refine the prompt after an unsatisfactory result because each retry may create a new charge.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill when sound must align with specific video moments.
Do not request music, songs, or background scores.
Do not retry authentication failures repeatedly without checking Sonilo setup.

faq.question: What access does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires connected Sonilo MCP tools or an authenticated Sonilo CLI.

faq.question: Is a duration required?
faq.answer: Yes. Set a duration from 1 to 180 seconds.

faq.question: Which audio formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports WAV, MP3, AAC, and FLAC.

faq.question: Can generation incur charges?
faq.answer: Yes. Sonilo API calls may consume credits or incur charges.

faq.question: Can it match effects to video?
faq.answer: No. Use a video-to-SFX workflow when sounds must align with footage.

faq.question: What happens when a call times out?
faq.answer: The task continues remotely. Use its task identifier with the recovery tool to retrieve the result.
